title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ThresholdRule
description: ThresholdRule A base entity for concrete definition of thresholds. This datatype is abstract (TM Forum TMF649 Performance Thresholding 5.0.0, OpenAPI component ThresholdRule; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ThresholdRule:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ThresholdRule'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ThresholdRule' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ThresholdRule:<tmfId>. unique identifier

measurement.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdRule/properties/measurement'. PerformanceMeasurement reference: A PerformanceMeasurement is the observed value(s) of some PerformanceIndicatorSpecification.

consequence.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdRule/properties/consequence'. A threshold crossing or a threshold ceased to be crossing results in a Performance consequence.

perfAlarmSpecThresholdCrossingDescriptio.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdRule/properties/perfAlarmSpecThresholdCrossingDescription'. Defines the specification for threshold crossing alarms, including severity, type, probable cause, and additional context used when generating alarms.

performanceAlarmSpecification.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdRule/properties/performanceAlarmSpecification'. The specification of how to populate the alarm fields when generating a threshold crossing alarm

condition.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdRule/properties/condition'. A concrete threshold may have two possible values: 'Raise' - a threshold was crossed or 'Clear' - a threshold ceased crossing

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdRule/properties/name'. A word, term, or phrase by which a Performance threshold rule is known and distinguished from other threshold rules

severity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdRule/properties/severity'. A threshold can be generated in different severity levels. A crossing for each level may require a different condition and possibly trigger a different consequence. The supported severity levels are equivalent to the possible severity level of alarms. Examples are CRITICAL,MAJOR,MINOR,WARNING,INTERMEDIATE

allOf.description: A threshold crossing or a threshold ceased to be crossing results in a Performance consequence.

name.description: A word, term, or phrase by which a Consequence is known and distinguished from other measurements

allOf.description: Entity reference schema to be use for all entityRef class.

id.description: The identifier of the referred entity.

href.description: The URI of the referred entity.

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

Extensible.description: Base Extensible schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs - When used for in a schema it means that the Entity described by the schema MUST be extended with the @type

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

PerformanceAlarmSpecification.description: The specification of how to populate the alarm fields when generating a threshold crossing alarm

perfAlarmSpecAdditionalText.description: A value for the AdditionalText attribute as part of a threshold crossing alarm definition.

perfAlarmSpecAlarmType.description: A value for the AlarmType attribute as part of a threshold crossing alarm definition.

perfAlarmSpecSeverity.description: A value for the Severity attribute as part of a threshold crossing alarm definition. Examples are CRITICAL,MAJOR,MINOR,WARNING,INTERMEDIATE

perfAlarmSpecSpecificProblem.description: A value for the SpecificProblem attribute as part of a threshold crossing alarm definition

perfAlarmProbableCause.description: A value for the ProbableCause attribute as part of a threshold crossing alarm definition.

allOf.description: PerformanceMeasurement reference: A PerformanceMeasurement is the observed value(s) of some PerformanceIndicatorSpecification.
